versions.subject: feat: new rules related to service creation
versions.detection:
selection_root:
    Provider_Name: 'Service Control Manager'
    EventID: 7045
selection_service:
    - ImagePath|contains: 'MeshAgent.exe'
    - ServiceName|contains: 'Mesh Agent'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Provider_Name="Service Control Manager" EventID=7045 ImagePath="*MeshAgent.exe*" OR ServiceName="*Mesh Agent*"
